name: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System — RSS feeds
access: HTTPS GET to www.federalreserve.gov/feeds/*.xml (RSS 2.0); no key

rate_limit.source: No request-rate policy found on https://www.federalreserve.gov/disclaimer.htm or https://www.federalreserve.gov/feeds/feeds.htm (2026-10-23). Self-imposed polite pacing: one request every 5 s, one poll of one feed every 10 min.

failure_behavior: Connection errors, 429 or 5xx: bounded exponential backoff, then the source's run is recorded FAILED with the error; stored items remain and the source shows its last successful poll time.
verdict_reason: The Board states: 'Unless otherwise indicated, information on Board's website is in the public domain and may be copied and distributed without permission. Please cite to the Board as the source of the information.' Seals and logos are not used.

datasets.description: Federal Reserve Board press releases, all categories (headline, link, category, publication time, the feed's description)
datasets.coverage: Board press releases: monetary policy, banking regulation, enforcement, orders, other (20 items on 2026-10-23)
datasets.update_frequency: as releases are published (polled every 10 min)
datasets.availability_rule: first_seen receipt time; the feed's pubDate is kept as the publication time
datasets.rights_source: https://www.federalreserve.gov/disclaimer.htm (public domain unless otherwise indicated; cite the Board)
